title: Introduction
subtitle: Welcome to TaraHive and discover how it simplifies travel planning and collaboration.

blocks.text: TaraHive is an all-in-one travel planning platform designed to help individuals, families, and groups organize memorable trips with ease. Whether you are planning a weekend getaway or a multi-day vacation, TaraHive provides the tools you need to keep every part of your journey organized.
What Can You Do with TaraHive?
TaraHive combines trip planning, collaboration, and safety features into a single, easy-to-use application.

items: Collaborate with friends, family, or travel groups in real time.
Receive AI-powered travel suggestions based on your destination and weather.
View weather forecasts to better prepare for your trip.
Manage travel expenses and split costs with your group.
Access emergency assistance features, including SOS and nearby emergency services.

blocks.text: Instead of using multiple applications for planning, navigation, communication, and budgeting, TaraHive brings everything together in one convenient platform. This helps reduce planning time and allows you to focus on enjoying your journey.
Some features require an internet connection and location permission to provide the best experience.

The following sections of this manual will guide you through installing TaraHive, creating an account, navigating the interface, planning itineraries, collaborating with groups, and making the most of the application's features.
